extensionDescription.message: Chat with your chosen model endpoint and operate explicitly shared browser tabs.

stepShare.message: 2. Share this tab, or open a tab and visit a page, then share it.

approvalsHelp.message: Approvals let you allow one site visit or consequential action at a time.

stopHelp.message: Stop cancels the task and releases browser control.

httpWarning.message: Warning: HTTP is unencrypted. Page content and your API key can be read by others on the network; use only a trusted network.

storageHelp.message: Keys stay in local extension storage. Page data goes only to your chosen model endpoint.

pausedHelp.message: Complete the check or resolve the page problem in the tab, then continue.

messagePlaceholder.message: Ask Rapid to help with your tabs…

traceFailed.message: Could not copy debug trace. Check clipboard access.

shoppingExample.message: Compare the main prices of these products; ask before purchasing.

travelExample.message: Find travel options on this page and compare times and prices.

reservationsExample.message: Find available reservations for two people; ask before booking.

mailExample.message: Summarize the messages on this page and draft a reply; ask before sending.

openTabHelp.message: Visit a page in the new tab, then choose Use this tab.

invalidEndpoint.message: Use an HTTP(S) origin without a path, credentials, query or fragment.

insecureEndpoint.message: HTTP is allowed only on loopback, private LAN, or 100.64.0.0/10 addresses. Use HTTPS for other hosts.

permissionMissing.message: Endpoint permission missing. Save settings and allow access to this origin.

unreachable.message: Endpoint unreachable or blocked by CORS. Check that the server is running, the URL and network are correct, and CORS allows this extension origin.

unauthorized.message: HTTP 401: API key rejected. Check your saved API key.

forbidden.message: HTTP 403: access denied. Check endpoint access rules and CORS configuration.

endpointHTTP.message: The endpoint returned an HTTP error. Check its server logs.

invalidResponse.message: The endpoint returned invalid JSON. Check the endpoint URL.

noModels.message: The endpoint has no loaded models. Load a model and test again.

toolProbeTimeout.message: Connected. Warning: the tool-calling test timed out; tool support is unverified.

noTools.message: No tool-calling support detected: the model did not return the requested test tool call. Choose a model with tool support.

stoppedNotice.message: Stopped. No further actions will run.

stopNewChat.message: Stop the task before starting a new chat

stopSettings.message: Stop the task before changing settings

stopSharing.message: Stop the task before sharing another tab

debuggerDetached.message: Debugger detached. Keep working or stop?

loadError.message: $1 could not load. Reload or resolve the error in that tab, then press Continue. Rapid will verify the page again.

humanCheck.message: $1 requires a human check. Complete the verification in that tab, then press Continue. Rapid will verify that the check is gone.

overlayUnavailable.message: Overlay unavailable: $1. Panel Stop remains available.

modelHTTP.message: Rapid engine HTTP $1. Check API key and --cors-origins.

modelUnreachable.message: Rapid engine not reachable at $1 — start it with rapid-mlx serve <model>. $2

emptyReply.message: The model returned no final answer; task completion is unconfirmed.

unconfirmed.message: Task completion is unconfirmed: the model did not inspect or act on the browser.

stepLimit.message: Stopped at step cap ($1). Review progress before continuing.

tabTakeover.message: User takeover: tab $1 $2. It is no longer available.

takenOver.message: tab_taken_over: user owns this tab now

unownedTab.message: unowned_tab: use open_tab or ask the user to share a tab

detachedTab.message: tab_detached: ask the user to keep working

staleRefs.message: stale_ref: call read_page for fresh refs

sensitiveField.message: blocked_sensitive_field: ask the user to enter passwords or payment details

approvalChanged.message: stale_ref: target changed during approval; call read_page

offscreenTarget.message: offscreen_target: no visible area; inspect dialogs or choose another control

obscuredTarget.message: obscured_target: hit test failed and approved target is not visible/enabled

changedTarget.message: stale_ref: approved target changed before DOM activation

chooseEmpty.message: invalid_arguments: choose must contain an option label

ambiguousOption.message: ambiguous_option: multiple options match choose; use the returned outline to select an exact option

missingOption.message: option_not_found: text was filled, but no unique autocomplete option matched choose; inspect the fresh outline before continuing

navigationDuringRead.message: stale_ref: navigation during read; call read_page

formChanged.message: stale_ref: page changed while reading forms; call read_page again

chooseInvalid.message: invalid_arguments: choose must be nonempty and cannot combine with submit

repeatedCall.message: repeated_call: identical call already attempted without progress; do not repeat it. Use the last observation, change arguments, or give a final answer.

unobservedURL.message: unobserved_url: URL was not supplied by the user or seen as an href in an outline in this task. Click a link from the page or use site search; do not invent product or venue URLs.

blockedURL.message: blocked_url: browser internals, Web Store, credentials, files, and the engine are unavailable

malformedURL.message: blocked_url: malformed URL or host; use an absolute HTTP(S) URL without spaces in the host

malformedHost.message: blocked_url: malformed host; use a valid HTTP(S) hostname without encoded spaces

outlineTruncated.message: [outline truncated: $1 entries/cards omitted; use read_page(query) to narrow results.]

outlineMore.message: [More below/outside viewport; click known refs directly, or read_page(query) for omitted content.]

outlineNoMatch.message: [No matching text for the query; showing the normal viewport-first outline. Use these fresh refs for site search or other controls.]

observationUnavailable.message: Fresh observation unavailable: $1. Wait then read_page; do not repeat the action.

olderSteps.message: $1 older steps collapsed. Copy debug trace for the full record.
